question: What is the average overall rating of the football player Aaron Doran?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH first AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(variable AS BIGINT) AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE id ILIKE 'first_name' AND value = 'Aaron'
), last AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(variable AS BIGINT) AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE (id ILIKE 'last_name' OR id ILIKE 'lname') AND value ILIKE 'Doran%'
), full AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(variable AS BIGINT) AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE (id ILIKE 'player_name' OR id ILIKE 'name' OR id ILIKE 'full_name') AND value ILIKE 'Aaron Doran%'
), candidates AS (
  SELECT player_api_id FROM first
  INTERSECT
  SELECT player_api_id FROM last
  UNION
  SELECT player_api_id FROM full
)
SELECT c.player_api_id,
       COUNT(a.player_api_id) AS attrib_rows
FROM candidates c
LEFT JOIN table_1 a
  ON a.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY attrib_rows DESC NULLS LAST, player_api_id
LIMIT 10;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "aaron_doran_attributes" AS CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE aaron_doran_attributes AS
WITH first AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE id ILIKE 'first_name' AND value = 'Aaron'
), lastn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE (id ILIKE 'last_name' OR id ILIKE 'lname') AND value ILIKE 'Doran%'
), fullname AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE (id ILIKE 'player_name' OR id ILIKE 'name' OR id ILIKE 'full_name') AND value ILIKE 'Aaron Doran%'
), candidates AS (
  SELECT f.player_api_id FROM first f INNER JOIN lastn l USING (player_api_id)
  UNION
  SELECT player_api_id FROM fullname
), candidates_scored AS (
  SELECT c.player_api_id, COUNT(a.player_api_id) AS attrib_rows
  FROM candidates c
  LEFT JOIN table_1 a ON a.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
  GROUP BY 1
), chosen AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM candidates_scored
  ORDER BY attrib_rows DESC NULLS LAST, player_api_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.player_api_id, a.date, a.overall_rating
FROM table_1 a
JOIN chosen c ON a.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
WHERE a.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.date
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "aaron_doran_attributes" AS WITH first AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE lower(id) = 'first_name' AND value = 'Aaron'
), lastn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE (lower(id) = 'last_name' OR lower(id) = 'lname') AND value ILIKE 'Doran%'
), fullname AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT variable AS player_api_id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE lower(id) IN ('player_name','name','full_name') AND value ILIKE 'Aaron Doran%'
), candidates AS (
  SELECT f.player_api_id FROM first f INNER JOIN lastn l USING (player_api_id)
  UNION
  SELECT player_api_id FROM fullname
), scored AS (
  SELECT c.player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS attrib_rows
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN table_1 a ON a.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
  GROUP BY 1
), chosen AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM scored
  ORDER BY attrib_rows DESC, player_api_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.player_api_id, a.date, a.overall_rating
FROM table_1 a
JOIN chosen c ON a.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
WHERE a.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.date

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(overall_rating), 2) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM aaron_doran_attributes

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(overall_rating) AS rated_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(overall_rating), 2) AS avg_overall_rating,
    MIN(date) AS min_date,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM aaron_doran_attributes
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN rated_rows > 0 THEN CAST(avg_overall_rating AS VARCHAR) ELSE 'N/A' END AS avg_overall_rating,
  total_rows AS attribute_rows,
  rated_rows AS rated_rows,
  min_date AS first_attr_date,
  max_date AS last_attr_date,
  CASE
    WHEN total_rows = 0 THEN 'No attribute snapshots for Aaron Doran found in dataset.'
    WHEN rated_rows = 0 THEN 'Attributes present but overall_rating is missing in all snapshots.'
    ELSE 'Computed over rated snapshots only.'
  END AS note
FROM stats
